CertNoThreeElementVerification.description_en: Three-element (name, ID card number, and ID card photo) verification. Used to compare whether the three pieces of information (the name and ID card number filled in by the user and the uploaded portrait photo) belong to the same user
CertNoThreeElementVerification.description_zh: 三要素（姓名、身份证号和身份证照）核验。用于比对用户填写的姓名、身份证号及上传的人像照片三项信息是否属于同一用户

CertNoTwoElementVerification.description_en: Two-element (name and ID card number) verification. Used to verify whether the name and ID card number entered by a user belong to the same person
CertNoTwoElementVerification.description_zh: 二要素（姓名和身份证）核验。用于比对用户填写的姓名、身份证两项信息是否属于同一用户

CompanyFourElementsVerification.description_en: Verifies the enterprise name, enterprise certificate number, enterprise legal person name, and enterprise legal person ID card number. All four items must be consistent and the enterprise's operating status must be active for verification to pass
CompanyFourElementsVerification.description_zh: 用于核验企业名称、企业证件号、企业法人姓名和企业法人身份证号，必须全部一致且企业经营状态为在营才会判定核验通过

CompanyThreeElementsVerification.description_en: Used to verify a company name, company certificate number, and the name of the company's legal representative. Verification passes only when all three are consistent and the company's operating status is in business
CompanyThreeElementsVerification.description_zh: 用于核验企业名称、企业证件号和企业法人姓名，必须全部一致且企业经营状态为在营才会判定核验通过

CompanyTwoElementsVerification.description_en: Used to verify the enterprise name and enterprise certificate number. The name and certificate must be fully consistent, and the enterprise must be in operating status for the verification to pass
CompanyTwoElementsVerification.description_zh: 用于核验企业名称和企业证件号，名称和证件必须全部一致且企业经营状态为在营才会判定核验通过

DescribeEmptyNumber.description_en: Predicts whether a phone number is invalid by using AI algorithms
DescribeEmptyNumber.description_zh: 通过AI算法，预测手机号是否为空号

DescribePhoneNumberAnalysis.description_en: Obtains the result returned by phone number analysis
DescribePhoneNumberAnalysis.description_zh: 获取号码分析返回结果

DescribePhoneNumberAnalysisAI.description_en: Get the phone number analysis result
DescribePhoneNumberAnalysisAI.description_zh: 获取号码分析返回结果

DescribePhoneNumberOnlineTime.description_en: Queries the duration for which a mobile user has been registered on the carrier's network
DescribePhoneNumberOnlineTime.description_zh: 查询手机用户在运营商侧的在网时长

DescribePhoneNumberOperatorAttribute.description_en: Queries the carrier information of a phone number, including the province, city, basic carrier (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom, or China Broadnet), mobile virtual network operator (such as Alibaba Cloud Communication), whether the number has been ported, and the number segment
DescribePhoneNumberOperatorAttribute.description_zh: 查询手机号码的归属信息，包括：所属省份、所属城市、所属基础运营商（中国移动、中国联通、中国电信、中国广电）、移动转售企业（阿里通信等）、是否携号转网、归属号码段等

DescribePhoneTwiceTelVerify.description_en: Verifies whether a phone number has been recycled and reassigned by a carrier. You can quickly check whether a number has been reassigned in a single request
DescribePhoneTwiceTelVerify.description_zh: 验证手机号是否为运营商二次放号的号码，支持在一次请求中快速检验号码是否为二次放号

GetUAIDApplyTokenSign.description_en: This API only provides the signing functionality for acquiring an authorization token during UAID retrieval from the three-network operators
GetUAIDApplyTokenSign.description_zh: 该API仅提供三网运营商获取UAID能力中，获取授权Token环节的签名功能

HistoryThreeElementsVerification.description_en: Verifies whether a name, phone number, and ID number belonged to the same user at a specific point in time
HistoryThreeElementsVerification.description_zh: 用于验证指定时间点的姓名、手机号和身份证号是否属于同一用户

InvalidPhoneNumberFilter.description_en: Performs invalid phone number filtering operations
InvalidPhoneNumberFilter.description_zh: 进行无效号码过滤操作

ListContacts.description_en: Lists the alert contacts for Number Encyclopedia
ListContacts.description_zh: 列表查询号码百科告警联系人

PhoneNumberEncrypt.description_en: Encrypts an original phone number into a virtual phone number that starts with 140. By integrating with Alibaba Cloud communication services, you can use the encrypted 140 phone number to initiate voice calls, achieving the effect of a virtual phone number call
PhoneNumberEncrypt.description_zh: 将原始号码加密为一个140开头的虚拟号码。通过结合阿里云的通信服务，可以使用加密后的140号码发起语音呼叫。实现虚拟号码呼叫的效果

PhoneNumberStatusForAccount.description_en: Retrieves the real-time network status of a mobile phone number, such as active, shutdown, or non-existent. You can query numbers that are in plaintext or hashed using MD5 or SHA256
PhoneNumberStatusForAccount.description_zh: 获取手机号码实时在网状态，例如正常、停机、空号等状态。支持明文、MD5/SHA256加密方式的号码查询

PhoneNumberStatusForPublic.description_en: Queries the real-time status of a mobile phone number to determine whether it is in service, suspended, or non-existent. This operation supports queries for plaintext numbers or numbers encrypted with MD5 or SHA256
PhoneNumberStatusForPublic.description_zh: 获取手机号码实时在网状态，例如正常、停机、空号等状态。支持明文、MD5/SHA256加密方式的号码查询

PhoneNumberStatusForReal.description_en: Queries the real-time status of a mobile phone number, such as normal, suspended, or not in service. This operation supports queries for phone numbers that are in plaintext or encrypted by using MD5, SHA256, or SM3
PhoneNumberStatusForReal.description_zh: 获取手机号码实时在网状态，例如正常、停机、空号等状态。支持明文、MD5/SHA256加密方式的号码查询

PhoneNumberStatusForSms.description_en: Retrieves the real-time network status of a phone number, such as active, shutdown, or non-existent. This operation supports queries for numbers in plaintext or numbers encrypted by using MD5, SHA256, or SM3
PhoneNumberStatusForSms.description_zh: 获取手机号码实时在网状态，例如正常、停机、空号等状态。支持明文、MD5/SHA256加密方式的号码查询

PhoneNumberStatusForVoice.description_en: Queries the real-time network status of a mobile phone number, such as normal, shutdown, or non-existent. This operation supports queries for numbers in plaintext and numbers encrypted by using MD5, SHA256, or SM3
PhoneNumberStatusForVoice.description_zh: 获取手机号码实时在网状态，例如正常、停机、空号等状态。支持明文、MD5/SHA256加密方式的号码查询

QueryTagListPage.description_en: Queries the tag list by page

QueryTaskList.description_en: Queries a list of offline tasks

QueryUsageStatisticsByTagId.description_en: Queries usage statistics by tag ID
QueryUsageStatisticsByTagId.description_zh: 根据标签ID查询用量统计

ThreeElementsVerification.description_en: Verifies three elements (name, phone number, and ID card number). Compares whether the name, phone number, and ID card number provided by a user belong to the same person
ThreeElementsVerification.description_zh: 三要素（姓名、手机号和身份证号）核验。用于比对用户填写的姓名、手机号、身份证号三个信息是否属于同一用户

TwoElementsVerification.description_en: Verifies two elements (name and phone number). Compares whether the name and phone number provided by a user belong to the same person
TwoElementsVerification.description_zh: 二要素（姓名和手机号）核验。用于比对用户填写的姓名、手机号两项信息是否属于同一用户

UAIDVerification.description_en:
Obtains a UAID based on the carrier authorization token.
For information about how to obtain the authorization token and its signature, see the GetUAIDApplyTokenSign API documentation.

A UAID is 64 characters in length. The first 32 characters describe the device information, and the last 32 characters describe the phone number information
UAIDVerification.description_zh:
根据运营商授权Token获取UAID。
获取授权Token及其签名值请参考GetUAIDApplyTokenSign API文档。

UAID为64个长度，前32个长度描述设备信息，后32个长度描述号码信息

VirtualThreeElementsVerification.description_en: Verifies whether a user's name, phone number, and ID card number are consistent
VirtualThreeElementsVerification.description_zh: 用于验证用户姓名、手机号和身份证号是否一致的API
